description: This file defines the 'Review' controller class within the OpenCart project, responsible for handling product review display, listing, and submission functionalities in the catalog. It includes methods for rendering review pages, fetching review lists with pagination, and processing review submissions with validation and captcha support.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Controller class for handling product reviews, including rendering review pages, listing reviews with pagination, and submitting new reviews with validation and captcha.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main review page for a product, including loading language files, scripts, preparing review data, captcha, and returning the view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of reviews, primarily for AJAX or embedded calls, by setting the response output to the review list.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches reviews for a specific product with pagination details, prepares data including review text, rating, date, and pagination controls, and returns the rendered review list view.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Handles submission of a new review, including validation of tokens, review content, user authentication, purchase verification, captcha, saving the review if valid, and returning JSON response.
